html:
Climb, tumble, and rage — the ruthless obstacle race for bunnies with nerves of steel.

Play alone or online against up to 8 players: whoever reaches the top wins. Everyone else… falls down in spectacular fashion.

Master dangerous parkour routes, dodge nasty traps, and jump with the precision of a bunny on espresso. One wrong step, one jump too early and boom, back to the start.

Challenge your friends, chase each other through chaotic levels, and fight for a spot on the global leaderboard. Only the fastest earn the title “Golden Bunny” complete with an epic fireworks show.

Features

  • Challenging climbing and parkour levels with fair checkpoints

  • Online multiplayer for up to 8 players

  • Global leaderboard with time comparison

  • Traps, checkpoints, and wonderfully frustrating “One more try!” moments included

  • Average playtime: 60–120 minutes… or hours? (highly dependent on fall rate 🐰💀)

How far will YOU get — and how many times will you have to start all over again?
